spans.text: Rather than being strictly what their name describes, a thesite elemental is a manifestation of the radiation pouring from thesite that has mutated the elements around it. Natural minerals are given life and develop crystalline properties as their molecular structures rearrange themselves. The resulting elemental beings are highly territorial, protecting the source of their mutation (which, without regular exposure to, they cannot continue to survive). These elementals are predatory and violent toward other forms of sapient life, seeing anything that could be intelligent enough to see value in its originating thesite to be a possible threat.

The universe of Somnus Domina can boil all of its greatest mysteries down to the Cosmic Teardrops: two (three as of the last century) crystal meteors that appeared mysteriously on the edge of the universe and tore their way through it, striking Somnus Domina and altering its fate. Chunks of its crystal husk broke off from the meteors as they moved through space and collided with other planets and debris. They also broke off from the second Cosmic Teardrop when it was attacked before making landfall. These chunks were made of a crystal material called thesite — the substance of the meteors.

Thesite is imagination and potential given form. It is a crystal material that responds to thought and intention, and can produce and focus eidomantic radiation. It was used as the base material for all of the weapons that Somnus Domina’s Eidolons used during an ancient war between gods and titans, and remains the basis for all constellequaries. This material is dangerous, however. It represents a physically manifested hole poked through the veil of reality, through which alternate realities—some imaginary—bleed into each other.
Across the universe, thesite is considered the single most valuable and versatile substance to use for practically any application.
, the unique effects of thesite equipment are included in the Treasury section.
